title: Corporate Finance
description: Corporate Finance develops the analytical and judgment skills needed to allocate capital, value investments and firms, design financing, manage liquidity and risk, evaluate transactions, and communicate decisions. Students build a common foundation in cash flow, present value, risk, cost of capital, capital budgeting, capital structure, payout, valuation, M&A, and international finance. They then apply those ideas through auditable models, cases, stress tests, and a board- or investment-committee-quality capstone.

resources.title: Principles of Finance
resources.description: OpenStax. Free foundation for TVM, valuation, risk, capital budgeting, cost of capital, financing, and working capital.

resources.title: Principles of Corporate Finance
resources.description: Brealey, Myers, Allen, and Edmans. Rigorous common reference for investment, financing, payout, risk, options, and international finance.

resources.title: Corporate Finance
resources.description: Berk and DeMarzo. Modern unified treatment with strong valuation logic, applications, and graduate-ready extensions.

resources.title: Applied Corporate Finance
resources.description: Aswath Damodaran. Real-company application of objective, investment, financing, payout, and valuation decisions.

resources.title: Valuation: Measuring and Managing the Value of Companies
resources.description: Koller, Goedhart, and Wessels. Enterprise DCF, value drivers, ROIC, growth, multiples, and managerial value creation.

resources.title: Financial Modeling
resources.description: Simon Benninga. Spreadsheet-based finance models, valuation, simulation, options, and implementation practice.

resources.title: Investment Banking: Valuation, LBOs, M&A, and IPOs
resources.description: Rosenbaum and Pearl. Practitioner reference for comps, precedents, DCF, sources and uses, M&A, and LBO models.

resources.title: The Theory of Corporate Finance
resources.description: Jean Tirole. MS Finance extension for contracting, governance, incentives, capital structure, and control.

resources.title: MIT Sloan 15.401 Finance Theory I

resources.title: Wharton FNCE 6110 Corporate Finance
resources.description: Benchmark description for rigorous DCF, uncertainty, asset pricing, options, market efficiency, and financial policy.

resources.title: NYU Stern Damodaran Corporate Finance
resources.description: Full course, current lecture packets, spreadsheets, datasets, cases, problems, exams, and real-company projects.

resources.description: Company filings, notes, risk factors, segment data, debt terms, and transaction documents.

resources.title: CFA Institute Insights
